title: Nazi missions to Antarctica

tellings.quote: they were they were fascinated Antarctica they had several missions down there

plain: The Nazis are said to have been fascinated by Antarctica and to have sent several missions there. Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence official, mentions it briefly to Michels without giving a source: "they were fascinated Antarctica they had several missions down there." He raises it as a passing point, hinting that the frozen continent held some special interest for them.
